subject: general
question: The Suez Canal, which is very significant for commerce, was constructed in which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Egypt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Suez Canal is an artificial sea-level waterway in **Egypt**, connecting the **Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea** through the** Isthmus of Suez**.
 
• The canal is approximately 193.30 kilometers (120.11 miles) long.
 
• Construction began in 1859 and the canal officially opened on **November 17, 1869**.
 
• In March 2021, **the Ever Given**, a large container ship, ran aground and blocked the canal for **six days**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brazil **has an extensive **coastline** stretching approximately **7,491 kilometers (4,655 miles)** along the Atlantic Ocean.
 
• The** Amazon River **is the largest river in Brazil and the second longest in the world.
 
• **Argentina** has an extensive Atlantic Ocean **coastline **stretching about** 4,989 kilometers (3,100 miles)**.
 
• **Argentina’s** landscape includes the **Andes Mountains** in the west,** the Pampas plains** in the central region, and** Patagonian plateaus** in the south.
 
• Oman is located on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula, **Muscat is the capital city of Oman**.
